evals.prompt: 这个项目有 frontend、backend、worker 三个仓库，帮我生成 project wiki
evals.expected_output: Identifies multi-repo boundary, builds repo/package map, sets project_wiki to required, generates repo-wikis/<repo-slug>.md for repos missing a wiki, builds Repo Wiki status matrix distinguishing existing-wiki vs generated-wiki repos
assertions: Output identifies three repository boundaries (frontend/backend/worker) from git remote, workspace config, or directory structure.
Output builds a repo/package map with path, responsibility, tech stack, entry points, test commands, deployment units.
Output builds a Repo Wiki status matrix marking each repo as has-existing-wiki (cite) or no-wiki (generate repo-wikis/<repo-slug>.md).
Output does NOT copy an entire repo wiki into the Project Wiki; it only cross-references and summarizes.

evals.prompt: 这是单个仓库，帮我也做一下 project wiki
evals.expected_output: Writes a lightweight Project Wiki marking 'single-repo fact', does NOT mislabel it as multi-repo, does NOT rename main artifact to Repo Wiki; title/catalogue must say 'Project Wiki'
assertions: Output writes a lightweight Project Wiki even for a single repo, marking it as a single-repo fact.
Output does NOT mislabel a single-repo project as multi-repo.
Main artifact title and catalogue title say 'Project Wiki', not 'Repo Wiki'.

evals.expected_output: Generated repo wiki and Project Wiki must distinguish file-evidence-confirmed facts, code-inferred assumptions, and owner-to-confirm items; does not write guesses as facts
assertions: Output distinguishes file-evidence-confirmed facts from code-inferred assumptions and owner-to-confirm items.
Output does not write unverified guesses as confirmed project facts.
Output records risks, assumptions, and open questions marking which repo/module/downstream-stage is affected.

evals.prompt: 这个客户不允许看代码，但允许用已有文档，帮我生成 project wiki
evals.expected_output: Inherits code_exploration user_declined; does not inspect source/tests/config/CI; only uses user-allowed docs and existing artifacts; records the limitation
assertions: Output does NOT inspect source files, tests, config, or CI after the user declines code exploration.
Output only uses user-provided info, existing project-profile/config, existing product artifacts, and user-allowed documents.
Output records the code_exploration user_declined limitation and its downstream impact.

evals.prompt: 首次生成 Project Wiki。项目有前端代码和 PRODUCT.md，探测到 impeccable，但还没有 DESIGN.md。
evals.expected_output: Uses impeccable document once to create DESIGN.md, records its path and git commit in Project Wiki, and does not copy design tokens into the Wiki.
assertions: Detects impeccable through PRODUCT.md or the installed skill.
Routes first-time frontend documentation to impeccable document because DESIGN.md is absent.
Records the DESIGN.md path and generation commit, referencing rather than copying tokens/components.
Does not rerun document on every product slice.

evals.prompt: Project Wiki 的 Markdown 已写好，请生成 docs/repo-wiki/catalogue.json 和 _meta/status.md。
evals.expected_output: Runs generate_repo_wiki_meta.mjs; catalogue pages come from existing Markdown in docs/project-wiki and docs/repo-wiki; status records the current git commit/non-git marker. Does not hand-write either mechanical file.
assertions: Runs generate_repo_wiki_meta.mjs on the project root.
catalogue.json contains paths/titles derived from Markdown and excludes _meta/status.md.
_meta/status.md records current git commit or non-git and page count.
Does not hand-write catalogue.json or status.md for Project Wiki or Repo Wiki.
